symbol.note: RECONSTRUCTED 19 Sep 2026 from the client's US LOGO.png (6250px, opaque white). The flag in its open bracket, DRAWN BY CONSTRUCTION from ink boxes measured off the source, so it carries no trace error. Navy and red read --cdr-mark-navy and --cdr-mark-red; the white is negative space. The Canadian variant, the traced maple leaf, is /logo-symbol-ca.svg.

wordmark.note: RE-SET, not traced. Twelve geometric sans faces were fitted on scale-free ratios, then read against the source for letterforms (a two-storey a, a one-storey g, a straight-legged R): DM Sans 600, its tracking solved so Registry is as wide against its cap height as the source measures. Outlined to paths.

lockupHorizontal.note: The client's own geometry, positioned from boxes measured in their file. THE DECLARED LOCKUP: every visitor outside Canada sees it. The Canadian variant, /logo-horizontal-ca.svg, is shown to a visitor the edge places in Canada; the header chooses (SiteHeader -> CdrLogo).

lockupVertical.note: A STUDIO DECISION: the client sent no stacked form. The symbol centred over the name, one cap height apart. Canadian variant: /logo-vertical-ca.svg.

favicon.note: A static globe with a net of meridians and parallels, the studio's drawing of the client's animated GIF (a GIF favicon shows its first frame in most browsers). One style block, a light and a dark ink, the fleet's favicon format.

faviconIco.note: One 32x32 PNG entry, cut from the same reduction.

squareMaster.note: 1024, the reduction on the brand ground at 60%.

appleTouchIcon.note: 180, composed on the brand ground: iOS gives a home-screen icon no transparency.

maskable.note: 512, art at 50% so it clears Android's circular crop.

book.provenance: The client delivered logo.png (141x51) and favicon.ico (16/32/48) on 18 Sep 2026, and no vector. Every file in this suite is a studio reconstruction of that raster, generated by scripts/brand/domain-services.mjs in the mother and regenerable from it. The mark is a red maple leaf beside a two-line black wordmark.
openQuestions: THE ORIGINAL VECTOR. A logo that arrives as a 141px PNG almost always has an AI, EPS or PDF behind it. One file from whoever drew it replaces this whole reconstruction and removes the question of fidelity.
THE NAME ON THE MARK. The logo reads 'Domain Registry'. The site, and the six legal documents the client sent on 31 Aug 2026, read 'Corporate Domain Registry'. The wordmark cannot be right for both.
THE TYPEFACE. Segoe UI Bold is a measured inference, not a fact the client stated. If they know what it was set in, that answer beats the measurement.

A SECOND BRAND COLOUR, if one exists. The client supplied red and black and nothing else, so the site carries no secondary: hierarchy is doing its work through the neutral ramp and weight. That is a legitimate restrained palette, not a gap, but if they have a second colour nobody has sent it.
book.palette: OPTION 2, the owner's call on 18 Sep 2026: BLACK IS THE WORKING COLOUR AND RED IS RESERVED. The accent ramp is graphite, so primary buttons, focus rings and emphasis are near-black; the brand red appears only on the mark and the active tab underline. The reason is not taste: the design system drives Input, Select and Textarea FOCUS from the accent, and a red focus ring on a contact form reads as a validation error. The system error colour sits 1.14:1 from the brand red at fill strength, so a red accent would also have made every primary button look destructive.
